name: Neuro Wobble Reese
desc: Aggressive fifth-stacked reese with a fast filter wobble and a slow resonance swell — the darker, growlier child of the jungle reese.

code.full: note("<a1 a1 g1 a1 f1 f1 g1 e1>/2").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").add(note("0,7,0.1")).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.25, ${cut}*1.8).fast(2)).lpq(sine.range(${res}*.6, ${res}*1.4).slow(16)).shape(.6).attack(.004).decay(.12).sustain(.6).release(.06).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.72, ${gain}).fast(4)).room(.1).every(8, x => x.fast(2)).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("<[a1 a1 g1 a1] [f1 f1 g1 f1] [g1 g1 f1 g1] [e1 e1 g1 a1]>").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").add(note("0,7,12,0.1")).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.3, ${cut}*2.4).fast(4)).lpq(sine.range(${res}*.7, ${res}*1.5).slow(8)).shape(.6).attack(.003).decay(.08).sustain(.4).release(.05).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.7, ${gain}).fast(8)).room(.08).every(4, x => x.ply(2)).orbit(3).play()
